note: Independent re-audit against RFC 8050 Section 4.1 (Figure 1 RIB Entries with 4-byte Path Identifier for subtypes 8-11) at HEAD. dumpRIBForMRT (rib_mrt.go) uses IterateFamilyWire and IsAddPath to peel the 4-byte PathID and invoke OnRouteAddPath vs OnRoute; writeTableDumpV2 and ribSubtypeFor (dump.go) emit subtypes 8-11 with entryAddPath=true vs 2-5 with entryAddPath=false. TestRFC8050AddPathRIBEntryFollowsFigure1 byte-compares literal Figure 1 octets and decodes all four ADD-PATH subtypes. TestRFC8050DumpV2AddPathStoresPathID and TestRFC8050MRTSnapshotPreservesPathIDs prove all four AFI/SAFI pairs on default config for both ADD-PATH (base+4 body, PathIDs 7/42) and base layouts. TestRFC8050MRTDumpDefaultConfigKeepsPathIDs and TestRFC8050MRTDumpMixedAddPathState prove end-to-end RIB->MRT dumping with mixed per-peer/per-family ADD-PATH states; TestRIBRecordAddPathRoundTrip and TestRIBRecordRoundTrip cover codec round-trips.
